checks.foot_bottom_geometry: Four frozen MJCF sphere centers transformed by measured ankle quaternion/position, subtract unchanged sphere radius
checks.target_geometry_binding: run_push updates FLOOR_SIZES before scene construction; adapter checks target size against frozen profile
checks.contact_classifier: Reuses unchanged RelayStateLogger._relay_contacts; required robot/object/ground/cabinet link maps initialized; all original classifier channels retained
checks.torque_channel: Signed current-state clipped control force from Genesis get_dofs_control_force, matching original logger. Not unclipped planner torque, independent mechanical torque sensing, or previous-substep qf_applied
checks.normal_terminal_alignment: Removes redundant pre-command sample and records terminal state at completed command count times control_dt, matching main trace and joint trace
checks.mass_precision: world_params promotes each float32 link mass to float64 before summation; direct float32 accumulation would be less precise and is not used
checks.frozen_safety_report_identity: Collector permits per-attempt snapshot absolute paths only with exact execution root/entrypoint identity and manifest+file+report digest agreement; original monitor and approved adapter bytes must match reviewed version

remaining_limitations: A signal/exception during a four-substep control interval can leave the terminal state labelled with completed-command time rather than partial physics time. The physics/control sample-count mismatch prevents a safety pass; partial recordings must remain unknown and require careful clock interpretation. No runtime source change was made after freeze.
Source review and synthetic tests do not establish full task success or genuine physical safety coverage before a new measured run.
The force channel retains original monitor semantics; it is not an independent torque sensor or an assertion of previous-step applied impulse.
